posts.title: Getting Started on GroveMc: Your First Day!
posts.description: New to GroveMc? This guide covers everything you need to know to get started.
posts.content:
Welcome to GroveMc!

Congratulations on joining GroveMc! This guide will help you get started on your first day.

Step 1: Claim Your Starter Kit

Type /kit starter in chat to claim your free starter items.

Step 2: Explore the Spawn

Take a look around the spawn area to find shops, warp points, and other important locations.

Step 3: Start Mining

Mine resources to earn money and build your base.
posts.author: Admin

posts.title: How to Rank Up Fast in GroveMc
posts.description: Want to climb the ranks quickly? Here are the best strategies and tips.
posts.content:
Ranking Up Fast

Looking to become the top player? Here are the best ways to earn money and rank up quickly.

1. Mining

Mining is the most consistent way to earn money. Focus on diamond and netherite.

2. Farming

Build an automatic farm for passive income.

3. Trading

Buy low, sell high on the player market.

posts.title: Top 5 Ways to Earn Money on GroveMc
posts.description: Discover the best ways to earn money on our Minecraft prison server.
posts.content:
Money-Making Guide

Here are the top 5 ways to earn money on GroveMc.

1. Mining

Mine ores at the mines. Higher tiers = better rewards.

2. Fishing

Set up an AFK fishing farm for consistent income.

3. Farming

Build crop farms and sell produce.

4. Trading

Buy and sell items on the server market.

5. Events

Participate in server events for bonus rewards.
